sloka: दुरात्मा पृच्छ्यतामेष कुतः किं वा ऽस्य कारणम् ।वनभङ्गे च को ऽस्यार्थो राक्षसीनां च तर्जने ।। ५.५०.५।।।।
transliteration: durātmā pṛcchyatāmeṣa kutaḥ kiṁ vā 'sya kāraṇam ।vanabhaṅge ca ko 'syārtho rākṣasīnāṁ ca tarjane ।। 5.50.5।।।।

translations.english: "Enquire from this wicked one, why he has come and from where, Why he destroyed the garden and for what purpose he threatened the demonesses?
